question: Among carcinogenic molecules that contain at least one triple bond, find the average number of distinct elements present in their fourth atoms (e.g., TRxxx_4).

prediction.sql:
SELECT AVG(element_count) FROM (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.XCL_003) AS element_count
  FROM molecule m
  INNER JOIN atom a ON m.XCL_010 = a.XCL_002
  INNER JOIN bond b ON m.XCL_010 = b.XCL_005
  WHERE m.XCL_011 = '+' AND b.XCL_006 = '#' AND a.XCL_001 LIKE '%_4'
  GROUP BY m.XCL_010
)

  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.XCL_003) AS element_count
  FROM molecule m
  INNER JOIN atom a ON m.XCL_010 = a.XCL_002
  INNER JOIN bond b ON m.XCL_010 = b.XCL_005
  WHERE m.XCL_011 = '+' AND b.XCL_006 = '#' AND a.XCL_001 LIKE '%_4'
  GROUP BY m.XCL_010
)

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT AVG(element_count) FROM (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.XCL_003) AS element_count
  FROM molecule m
  INNER JOIN atom a ON m.XCL_010 = a.XCL_002
  INNER JOIN bond b ON m.XCL_010 = b.XCL_005
  WHERE m.XCL_011 = '+' AND b.XCL_006 = '#' AND a.XCL_001 LIKE '%_4'
  GROUP BY m.XCL_010
)

FROM (
    SELECT m.XCL_010, COUNT(DISTINCT a4.XCL_003) AS cnt
    FROM molecule m
    JOIN bond b ON m.XCL_010 = b.XCL_005
    JOIN connected c1 ON b.XCL_004 = c1.XCL_009
    JOIN connected c2 ON b.XCL_004 = c2.XCL_009
    JOIN atom a1 ON c1.XCL_007 = a1.XCL_001
    JOIN atom a2 ON c1.XCL_008 = a2.XCL_001
    JOIN atom a4 ON c2.XCL_008 = a4.XCL_001
    WHERE m.XCL_011 = 'carcinogenic'
      AND b.XCL_006 = 'triple'
    GROUP BY m.XCL_010
)
